name: tomboy-links
description: Make plain text that matches Markdown note titles clickable inside VS Code.

implicitMarkdownLinks.titleSources.description: Sources used to derive Markdown note titles, in priority order.

implicitMarkdownLinks.minTitleLength.description: Minimum title length before plain text can become an implicit link.

implicitMarkdownLinks.caseSensitive.description: Whether implicit title matching is case-sensitive.

implicitMarkdownLinks.scope.description: Whether note titles are matched across the full workspace or only the current file's folder and descendants.

implicitMarkdownLinks.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from Markdown note indexing.

implicitMarkdownLinks.decorationEnabled.description: Underline implicit links in Markdown editors.
